verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail confirms it has an API that users can use to control their workflow, so the core capability exists. However, it is not a documented public API: the help center says developer information is available only on request, the developers page is marketing only, and probes for an OpenAPI spec, llms.txt and docs endpoints all return 404 or 401. missing for 10: publicly available API reference documentation, a published OpenAPI/spec, sandbox and versioning docs, self-serve access without contacting support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: use our API directly to take full control of your workflow

we do offer an API that you can use. API access is currently available to those who may know how to program or code software. You can contact us to request for developer information on how to access the API.
